podcast.title: Millie Small's First British Single (1963)
podcast.body: Millie Small's debut British single, "Don't You Know," released in late 1963, was characterized as standard British pop music of the era, and its lack of distinctiveness contributed to its failure as a hit. "Milly's first British single, don't you know, was released in late 1963, and was standard British pop music of the time, with little to distinguish it."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs

podcast.title: The Smiths' Contribution
podcast.body: The Smiths contributed to British pop music with their short, sharp, and danceable singles, such as "This Charming Man." Their musical style had a profound impact, laying the groundwork for Britpop which would later dominate the British pop scene for nearly a decade. "Short, sharp, danceable, single-beled British pop music from the Smiths."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: What's The Big Deal About The Smiths
